suggested_bullets: Add a concrete achievement using 'instrumentation' (e.g., “Implemented instrumentation to improve a KPI by X%”).
Add a concrete achievement using 'rca' (e.g., “Implemented rca to improve a KPI by X%”).
Include at least email and phone (and optionally city/country).
Tailor keywords to the job description (mirror terminology where appropriate).
Start bullets with strong action verbs (Led, Built, Optimized, Spearheaded…).
Add a professional link (GitHub/LinkedIn/Portfolio) to showcase projects.
Split long lines into concise bullets (~1–2 lines each) to improve readability.
Avoid multi-column layouts/tables; use a single-column, ATS-friendly format.
Balance soft skills with evidence (teamwork, leadership) tied to measurable results.
format_warnings: Start more bullets with action verbs (Built, Implemented, Optimized…).
